name: 22_huygens_plane_wave_3d
energy_note: Staggered-field proxy; includes PML and is not an exact discrete invariant or calibrated joules.
detector_note: Mean sum of squared staggered electric components; not calibrated Poynting flux or antenna gain.
notes: Sources span x and propagate along y, so x is periodic and y is PML. The thesis caption swaps these axes. Uses the 532 nm wavelength from thesis printed p. 72, rather than 50 GHz in the exploratory MATLAB files. Uniform x-z source sheet; periodic z with eight cells gives the depth-independent plane-wave calibration limit of the six-component solver.
